The issuer shows solid profitability and adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.27, EBIT margin about 30%), but the balance sheet is fairly leveraged, with liabilities covering about 81% of assets and equity only about 19% of assets. Positive retained earnings and operating income support creditworthiness, yet the leverage profile looks more consistent with the upper speculative-grade range than with a stronger investment-grade issuer.

DECISION: BB+
